patterns.note: A stark, high-contrast layout featuring large blocks of black background with white text, punctuated by full-width accent sections.
Consistent use of a single, clean sans-serif typeface across all text elements, with significant size variations for hierarchy but maintaining a uniform weight character.
A minimalist color palette dominated by black and white, with a single vibrant lime green used exclusively for calls-to-action and key interactive elements.
Content sections and individual elements reveal with a subtle slide-up or fade-in animation as they scroll into the viewport, creating a progressive loading effect.
Project showcases are presented in a responsive grid layout, where each card features a distinct visual identity but maintains a consistent text structure below the image.

technique_notes: A fixed header containing the logo and navigation remains visible at the top of the viewport throughout scrolling.
Smooth scrolling is implemented across the site, likely using a library like Locomotive Scroll, providing a fluid user experience.

Scroll-triggered animations, powered by GSAP, are used to reveal new content sections and elements with a subtle upward slide and fade as they enter the user's view, enhancing engagement without being overly distracting.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized hero text (~3-4x body) with clear, well-spaced section headings and readable body text; client list uses a consistent medium-large size.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners for most interactive elements and content cards, with subtle rounding only on the cookie consent pop-up.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, especially in the hero and between major sections, creating a sense of spaciousness; content blocks within sections are balanced.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is its bold, high-contrast black and white aesthetic, dramatically punctuated by a single, vibrant lime green accent. This minimalist approach, combined with large, clean typography and generous spacing, creates a sophisticated and modern editorial feel that elevates the content.
